mapper.insert: insert into elasticsearch (`tenant_uuid`, `username`, `password`, `host`, `option`) values (#{tenantUuid}, #{username}, #{passwordPlain}, #{host}, #{option}) on duplicate key update `username` = #{username}, `password` = #{passwordCipher}, `host` = #{host}, `option` = #{option}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_uuid AS tenantUuid, username, `password` AS passwordCipher, `host`, `config` AS configStr FROM elasticsearch a JOIN `tenant` b ON a.tenant_uuid = b.uuid AND b.is_active = 1
SELECT tenant_uuid AS tenantUuid, username, `password` AS passwordCipher, `host`, `config` AS configStr FROM elasticsearch
SELECT tenant_uuid AS tenantUuid, username, `password` AS passwordCipher, `host`, `config` AS configStr FROM elasticsearch where tenant_uuid = #{value}
